- "Amen" at Communion = wedding vow — the personal "yes"
- The Eucharist constitutes the Church: *"He pours Himself into the Eucharist; the Eucharist pours Him into us; we, made one Body by what we receive, pour Him out into the world where the brother is still hungry."*
- Altar before Bible — the Mass provided the hermeneutical key
